messages.plaintextBody:
Tom - I've updated the recall cost model (attached). Gross ~£274k, net ~£164k assuming 55% recall-expense recovery net of the £75k excess. I've notified our product liability and recall-expense insurers within the window per your advice. Can you confirm the notification wording was adequate?

Nina
